messages.content: Answer the listed CURRENT travel preference fields from the supplied USER dialogue. Respect domains, changes, exceptions and explicit references. Assistant suggestions alone are not user decisions. Return JSON {"answers":{"hotel.area":"centre"}} keyed by every requested field; use UNKNOWN when unsupported. Normalize area centre/north/south/east/west; price cheap/moderate/expensive; stars digits; lodging type hotel/guesthouse; cuisine and attraction type lower-case. No confidence scores.

0 USER: Hello, I am looking for a Korean restaurant in the centre. Could you help me with that?
1 ASSISTANT: I have one restaurant name little seoul in the expensive price range. would you like me to book it?
2 USER: Are there any other choice? If not I would like to get a table on Wensday at 12 for 1 please.
3 ASSISTANT: I looked and this was the only restaurant serving korean food. I have booked you a table. The table will be reserved for 15 minutes. Ref# WH331DNY. Any thing else?
4 USER: Are there any places to go in the same area as the restaurant?
5 ASSISTANT: There are dozens of places to go in city centre. What type of attraction are you interested in today?
6 USER: I don't really mind, as long as it is near the restaurant. What looks good to you?
7 ASSISTANT: I would like to suggest all saints church located in the centre. Is that okay? 
8 USER: Yes that is fine can you please provide the postcode?
9 ASSISTANT: The postcode is cb58bs. Is there anything else I can help with?
10 USER: I also need a taxi to go between them and need it to arrive at the restaurant by the booked time.
11 ASSISTANT: I have booked a cab to take you to the restaurant when you leave All Saint's Church. The booked car type is a yellow volkswagen.
The contact number is 07396045902.
12 USER: Thanks so much, that's all I need today! 
13 ASSISTANT: My pleasure.  Have a great day.
14 USER: Goodbye again, thanks for your help. 
15 ASSISTANT: It's no problem, contact us again any time.
FIELDS ["attraction.area","restaurant.area","restaurant.food"]
